answer: Each challenge is instantiated only after a designated drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, using its verified output to derive task parameters and a nonce; thus an agent cannot know the challenge in advance to precompute answers or farm them offline across sybil identities. Commitments bind responses to that challenge, and reveals are checked against it. A karst-style task may route through an inlet, while each valid response creates a ripple in the public audit trail, making replay and identity-splitting detectable.
